__comment: Dwarf stats (doc 41), read by DwarfAssets. Each dwarf is given its stats when created, from its own seed after its tastes, and keeps them for life.
words: the five steps, Poor to Excellent. A step shows as pips and its word, never as a number.

average: the step every stat starts at. shifts: how many times a point then moves from one stat to another, never below the first step or above the last, so every dwarf has the same total in a different shape.
groups: the sheet's two columns, in order. stats: name, group, icon, description (the hover), in the sheet's order.

A stat that speeds work names its kinds (`work`: mining, felling, stonework (a Stonemason's crafting, doc 293), crafting, building, fishing) and what the sheet says (`does`, {speed} being '6% faster', 'at the usual speed' or '6% slower'); per_step is the work speed for each step from Average (doc 41). Toughness gives the hit points (`health` in task_config.json). The others give `effect`, what they will do, shown as 'Not active yet: ...'.
Each profession names its main and second stat in data/professions/professions.json; Iron Constitution and Frail shape Toughness in traits.json.

base:stat:strength.name: Strength
base:stat:strength.description: Muscle: the heavy work of digging, felling, clearing and shaping stone.
base:stat:strength.does: Digs, fells, clears and shapes stone {speed}

base:stat:agility.description: Quick feet and a sure aim.
